# Assumption ledger — Gosling shared shell productization

Assumptions are conservative defaults, not verified facts. Each must be confirmed, superseded, or carried visibly into final handoff.

## Review policy

- `binding` assumptions are treated as requirements unless amended by operator-approved plan change.
- `unresolved` assumptions block any dependent production/release decision but need not block fixture implementation.
- Gate 8 handoff lists every assumption not confirmed by observed evidence.
